chapters.title: Faith growing under trial
chapters.summary: Paul thanks God that the Thessalonians' faith is growing despite persecution, and assures them God will bring justice when Jesus is revealed.

chapters.title: The day has not yet come
chapters.summary: The day of the Lord has not already come; a man of lawlessness must first be revealed. Stand firm and hold to the teaching you received.

chapters.title: Do not grow weary
chapters.summary: Pray that the word spreads. Those who refuse to work should not eat. Do not grow weary in doing good. The Lord of peace give you peace always.
